summary: The registrant, Virax Biolabs Group Ltd, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing positive early pilot performance data for its ViraxImmune blood-based test for Long COVID and related syndromes. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is a routine disclosure of clinical development progress with no special-situation corporate event. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of ordinary business operations.
